$docs.$self: Derived from brand.json `features`. Every flag that is true maps through LEGACY_FLAG_MODULE_MAP (packages/module-kit/src/registry.ts) to the module that replaces it: drops, catering, delivery, stored_value, referrals and operations. multi_location and sms are deliberately unmapped -- they are capacity and integration settings on the brands row, not capabilities -- so no module appears for them here.
$docs.dependencies: commerce-catalog and commerce-ordering are not flags. They are named because every commerce and growth module above depends on them, and resolveModules would pull them in regardless; listing them keeps the manifest an honest account of what is installed rather than a list of what was switched on.
$docs.device-wall: Installed because modules/device-wall.json is authored for this tenant with `enabled: true`; the HQ console already reads that artifact directly.
